messages:
alex: Noticed a weird hang in the Node sample app after upgrading to js-sdk@2.4. Paginator-based ingestion stops issuing requests mid-run. Repro: sampleapps/large-ingest, 8 concurrency, windowSize=256, ~10k items — it freezes after a while.

maria: Do you have logs? Could be backpressure or retry interactions.

alex: Logs show token refresh then a wait on window semaphore that never resolves. No exceptions, process still alive but no outgoing calls. Snippet: 
```
2026-11-02T16:12:01.234Z DEBUG sdk: acquiring window-semaphore
2026-11-02T16:12:01.235Z DEBUG sdk: token refresh triggered (401)
2026-11-02T16:12:01.237Z DEBUG auth: start-refresh
2026-11-02T16:12:03.900Z DEBUG auth: refresh-complete, new-token
2026-11-02T16:12:03.901Z DEBUG sdk: waiting on window-semaphore (held by another request)
// then nothing for minutes
```

alex: My hunch: refresh path and window/queue bookkeeping are contending for the same lock/semaphore causing effective deadlock when multiple inflight requests hit 401.

sam: Which SDK and environment? Node only? Browser?

alex: Node (js-sdk 2.4.0). Python apps handled it differently — they push refresh to a background queue so they never hold the window lock while refreshing.

jordan: Can you paste the paginator call site? Might be useful.

alex: Sure:
```
const p = new Paginator({concurrency: 8, windowSize: 256});
for await (const page of p.listAll(items)) {
  await processPage(page);
}
```
Paginator manages the in-flight window and acquires/release semaphores per request. When a request gets a 401 the SDK does `await refreshToken()` while still inside the critical section. If the refresh triggers other requests to run (or the refresh path tries to re-enqueue/resend) they block waiting for the same semaphore -> hang.

maria: We have at least two fixes: 1) move token refresh out of the window lock (don't hold lock across network ops), 2) implement single-flight refresh utility so only one refresh runs and others await it without touching window state. I prefer #2 for minimal risk to window invariants.

eli: SDK parity note: node used to do inline refresh; python deferred. We should align behavior and add a single-flight helper in core-auth so both SDKs share it.

alex: I hacked a local mitigation: backgroundRefresh() (non-blocking) + semaphore.tryAcquire(timeout=2000) fallback. That eliminated the hang in my runs. But we need a clean fix.

sam: Also add a semaphore watchdog to help detect long-held locks in prod: if held > X ms, emit a diagnostic trace and optionally release for emergency recovery (configurable).

jordan: For tests: add a small e2e that simulates an auth storm: 20 concurrent requests, orchestrate the auth server to return 401 for the first wave, ensure no deadlocks and progress continues. Also a unit test for single-flight semantics.

maria: Alex please open a repro branch in sampleapps and link it here. Add a minimal test that reproduces under CI. Tag me and sam in the PR. Also add a changelog note that apps on js-sdk v2.4 may see hangs for high-concurrency paginators so customers can pin or update. :warning:

alex: Opening branch now. Pushed small repro and a flaky test harness that uses an injected auth stub. CI run: alex/paginator-auth-repro #7

ci-bot: CI started for branch alex/paginator-auth-repro #7

eli: One more thought: ensure token refresh is idempotent and safe to call concurrently (so single-flight can be a thin layer over existing refresh). Also expose an opt-in config on Paginator for semaphoreTimeoutMs so users can enable timeouts during troubleshooting. Default off.

sam: If we add semaphoreTimeoutMs, document the caveats: forced release may duplicate in-flight bookkeeping and could cause duplicate requests; best paired with idempotent backends or dedupe keys.

jordan: I can take the single-flight impl for node, will add to auth/core and update docs. Maria take the test matrix for parity.

alex: CI passed on the repro branch (tests 12/12). Opening PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapps/pull/214 — patch includes single-flight refresh util, moves refresh out of window critical section, and adds semaphoreTimeoutMs (off by default) + one e2e that simulates auth storms.

maria: Reviewing now. Thanks for the quick turn.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR alex/paginator-auth-repro #214 (e2e: 1/1, unit: 18/18) :white_check_mark:
